Name: Adamantine Breastplate
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 124, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 464
Description: This nonmagical breastplate is made of adamantine, giving its wearer damage reduction 2/—.

Name: Advocate's Armor
Description: The papery layers of this robe barely constitute what would be traditionally called armor, yet act as +3 leather armor. Once per day, when the wearer is struck by a critical hit or sneak attack, he can choose to have his blood splatter across one of the paper layers and form the words of a binding deal between the attacker and the wearer. The wearer can put the opponent under a specific restriction for 24 hours, such as “I will not attack elves,” or “I will attack only those who attacked me first.” The terms of the contract must be simple enough for the creature to comprehend and spoken in a language it understands. This acts as a lesser geas spell, except without a limit to how many Hit Dice the target can have. A successful DC 19 Will save negates this effect.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: geas/quest, Special: creator must make a pact with a devil.

Name: Alchemist's Suit
Description: This bizarre +1 quilted cloth armor holds eight small vials that can be filled with potions, poisons, or other alchemical substances, plus numerous decoys. If the wearer is struck by a bludgeoning attack or critical hit, is grappled, takes constrict damage, or is swallowed whole, the wearer can choose one vial to break as an immediate action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. The wearer must choose himself or his attacker as the target of the vial’s contents, which immediately produce their effect. If the wearer is the target, the effect functions at half strength and for half the normal duration (minimum 1 round). For example, a potion of cure moderate wounds broken in this manner cures half as many hit points as normal. If the wearer’s opponent is the target, the wearer must attempt a touch attack against the opponent to apply the effect. If the attack is successful, the opponent is affected as if struck by the vial’s contents. If the vial contains a substance that would harm the opponent only upon ingestion, the opponent can avoid being affected if she succeeds at a DC 15 Reflex save.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: shrink item

Name: All-Seeing Armor
Description: This +1 chain shirt is made of shiny, bright rings on the left side and dull, dark rings on the right. At will, the wearer can use detect magic and read magic. Once per day, the wearer can use comprehend languages

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: comprehend languages, detect magic, read magic

Name: Aquadynamic Armor
Description: This sleek and mobile armor is magically streamlined to assist in swimming rather than making swimming more difficult, granting the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, water breathing

Name: Aquadynamic Armor, Improved
Description: This sleek and mobile armor is magically streamlined to assist in swimming rather than making swimming more difficult, granting the wearer a +10 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, water breathing

Name: Aquadynamic Armor, Greater
Description: This sleek and mobile armor is magically streamlined to assist in swimming rather than making swimming more difficult, granting the wearer a +15 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, water breathing

Name: Arachnid Harness
Description: This formfitting black +1 leather features eight ridged support ribs along the back. On command, the arachnid harness sprouts eight enormous spidery legs from these ribs. These legs allow the armor’s wearer to attempt Climb checks at full speed without needing to use her hands or feet. Additionally, while the legs are deployed, the armor’s wearer doesn’t lose her Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing, and need not succeed at a Climb check to avoid falling if she takes damage while climbing.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: spider climb

Name: Arboreal Armor
Description: The oaken plates of this +1 wild wooden armor are rough with untreated bark. The wearer can activate the armor with a command word, causing her flesh to become treelike in appearance and resilience. This grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to her existing natural armor bonus and removes her need to breathe, but reduces her speed by half and imposes a –2 penalty on Reflex saves. This effect remains until dismissed as a free action. The wearer can use this ability for up to 10 rounds per day, though the rounds need not be consecutive.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor Spells: baleful polymorph, barkskin

Name: Armiger's Armor
Description: This +1 adamantine light fortification full plate is crafted from tightly fitted smooth, dull plates trimmed in gold. As adamantine heavy armor, it grants its wearer DR 3/—. When the armor is not worn, a creature can touch the armor and speak a command word to cause the armor to leap up and fit itself to that creature. The armor is considered properly donned when put on in this way. The wearer can speak the command word to have the armor remove itself and, if not restrained, stack itself neatly nearby or arrange itself on an appropriate armor rack, if one is adjacent.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: animate objects, limited wish or miracle, Special: creator must be proficient with heavy armor.

Name: Armor of Fragmenting Stone
Description: This imposing suit of armor, first forged by elemental binders, is covered in large, jagged stones and functions as +2 full plate. Once per day as an immediate action, when a bludgeoning or slashing attack strikes the wearer, the wearer can will a chunk of the stone to break off, summoning a Medium earth elemental as summon monster IV. The elemental fights as the wearer directs (and understands the wearer, even if the two do not share a language) for 7 rounds, or until it is destroyed.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: summon monster IV or summon nature's ally IV, Special: creator must have visited the Elemental Planes of Earth.

Name: Armor of Insults
Description: Each metal bit of this suit of +1 studded leather looks more like a tiny sneering face than a simple stud. Once per day the wearer of the armor may command the mouths to unleash a torrent of verbal abuse directed against every hostile creature within 60 feet who can see and hear the wearer. Each such creature must make a DC 16 Will saving throw to avoid suffering an overwhelming compulsion to attack the wearer for the next 7 rounds. If the creature is unable to attack the wearer on its next turn, or attacking the wearer would put the creature at risk (moving through a threatened square, charging into a pit, and so on) it can act normally that turn. This is a mind-affecting sonic effect, and has no effect on creatures that do not use a spoken language.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: confusion

Name: Armor of the Pure Legion
Description: This suit of +1 steel lamellar armor grants its wearer spell resistance against divine spells equal to 5 + the wearer’s base attack bonus. It also protects the wearer from heat dangers as if she were affected by a continuous endure elements spell. Additionally, once per day when the wearer of a suit of armor of the Pure Legion fails a Will save against a mind-affecting spell cast by a divine spellcaster, she can attempt another save as a free action on the following round to end the spell.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: endure elements, mind blank

Name: Armor of the Sands
Description: This +2 leather armor is made of camel hide and has been worn smooth as if blasted by sand. The wearer is protected from mundane extremes of cold and heat (as the endure elements spell), and can see normally in sandstorms, dust storms, and similar conditions. Once per day as a swift or immediate action, the wearer can briefly turn to sand when hit by an attack but before damage is determined. For the purposes of resolving the damage, the wearer is treated as an incorporeal creature. Only a single attack is affected by each use of this ability.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: stoneskin

Name: Armor of the Unquenchable Fire
Description: This blue-black +1 defiant chainmail has a metal badge depicting a three-dagger symbol fused to it. Each of these suits of armor is crafted with a particular type of foe in mind for the defiant property, as appropriate for the vengeance the original crafter sought. Once per day, the wearer can use charm person (lasting 1 hour)

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: charm person, summon monster I

Name: Backbreaker Mail
Description: This +2 spiked splint mail is fashioned from hacked-off chunks of tanned hide and held together by humanoid spines. Used by orcs, these sets of armor are seen as a status symbol, and are adorned with trophies from slain foes, such as wayfinders. This armor grants its wearer the constrict ability, dealing an amount of damage equal to 1d6 + the wearer’s Strength modifier. The vertebrae of the spines adorning the backbreaker mail are sharpened, acting as +1 human bane armor spikes.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: beast shape I, disguise self, summon monster I

Name: Banded Mail of Luck
Description: Ten 100-gp gems adorn this +3 banded mail. Once per week, the armor allows its wearer to require that an attack roll made against him be rerolled. He must take whatever consequences come from the second roll. The wearer’s player must decide whether to have the attack roll rerolled before damage is rolled.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: bless

Name: Blackfingers Apron
Description: This +1 bitter leather armor looks much like a blacksmith’s apron or an alchemist’s smock, and has many small pockets suitable for holding extracts, potions, or poisons. Once per day, the wearer can use negate aroma (lasting 1 hour). This effect suspends the armor’s bitter special ability if used on the wearer. Once per day, the wearer can pull a tanglefoot bag from one of the apron’s pockets, although the bag crumbles into dust if it is not used within 1 minute

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: negate aroma, stinking cloud, web

Name: Boneless Leather
Description: This suit of +1 leather gives its wearer the ability to twist and contort her body in virtually any direction. She gains a +5 bonus on Escape Artist checks, a +5 bonus on Acrobatics checks to reduce damage from falls, a +5 bonus to CMD, and DR 5/piercing or slashing.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: alter self, Special: creator must have 5 ranks in Acrobatics and Escape Artist.

Name: Breastplate of Command
Description: This +2 breastplate typically bears the image of a rampant grizzly bear or other impressive predator. It bestows a commanding aura upon its wearer. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on all Charisma checks, including Charisma-based skill checks. The wearer also gains a +2 competence bonus to his Leadership score. Friendly troops within 360 feet of the user become braver than normal, gaining a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against fear. Since the effect arises in great part from the distinctiveness of the armor, it does not function if the wearer hides or conceals herself in any way.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: mass charm monster

Name: Breastplate of the Planes
Description: This sturdy, unadorned breastplate has a +1 enhancement bonus on the Material Plane. On any Elemental Planes, or against attacks made by creatures native to any Elemental Planes, its enhancement bonus increases to +2. On the Astral Plane or the Ethereal Plane, or against attacks made by creatures native to either of those planes, its enhancement bonus increases to +3. On any other plane, or against attacks made by any outsider, its enhancement bonus increases to +4.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: plane shift

Name: Breastplate of Vanishing
Description: This battered +1 mithral breastplate bears a resemblance to a stylized turtle shell. On command, its wearer can vanish inside the armor, leaving the breastplate behind while she stays safely hidden in an extradimensional space. This space is barely large enough for the wearer to sit comfortably, but does provides breathable air and light to see by. The wearer cannot perceive the environs around the armor while inside. A second command word returns the wearer to the armor’s location, wearing the armor. If the wearer can’t return to the space the armor is in, she is instead shunted to the nearest empty space that can contain her, but no longer wearing the armor. If the breastplate is destroyed, the wearer immediately returns to the square the armor was in when it was destroyed. Successfully dispelling the armor likewise returns the wearer, though in this case still wearing the armor.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: rope trick

Name: Buccaneer's Breastplate
Description: This +1 breastplate is made of shining amber metal and decorated with faint motifs of the waves and water. It allows the wearer to continually utilize the effects of the spell water walk. If a creature puts on the armor while underwater, the wearer is borne toward the surface at a rate of 60 feet per round.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: water walk

Name: Catskin Leather
Description: Rather than the hide of a cat, this extremely supple suit of jet-black +1 shadow leather armor grants a portion of the grace and fortune of a feline. It has no armor check penalty or maximum Dexterity bonus. The wearer receives a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks and takes only half normal damage from falling. When the wearer’s hit points would be reduced to a negative amount equal to her Constitution score from an attack or spell, the armor falls to pieces and is destroyed, and the wearer takes only half damage from the attack or spell.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: cat's grace, feather fall, and limited wish, or miracle

Name: Celestial Armor
Description: This +3 chainmail is so fine and light that it can be worn under normal clothing without betraying its presence. It has a maximum Dexterity bonus of +8, an armor check penalty of –2, and an arcane spell failure chance of 15%. It is considered light armor and allows the wearer to use fly on command (as the spell) once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: fly, Special: creator must be good

Name: Celestial Plate Armor (3.5E)
Description: Celestial plate armor is a sturdier version of the standard celestial armor. This bright silver suit of +3 full plate is remarkably light, and is treated as medium armor. It has a maximum Dexterity bonus of +6, an armor check penalty of –3, and an arcane spell failure chance of 20%. It allows the wearer to use fly on command (as the spell) once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: fly, Special: creator must be good

Name: Chain Vest of Dawn
Description: This red-and-gold +1 spell storing chain shirt is designed to be worn over or between multiple layers of clothing such as garments suited for desert-traveling. At will, the wearer can use light and stabilize.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: light, stabilize, Special: creator must be a caster of at least 12th level

Name: Clockwork Armor
Description: This suit of +2 field plate is composed of durable plates of steel layered over an intricate framework of gears, springs, and pistons that move with mechanical precision. A suit of clockwork armor requires a special winding key to function; this key is created as part of making a suit of clockwork armor. In order to function, a suit of clockwork armor must be fully wound as a full-round action. Once fully wound, a suit of clockwork armor functions for 4 hours. If a suit of clockwork armor is not fully wound, its gears grind to a halt and it imposes double its normal armor check penalty and a –2 penalty to its wearer’s Strength and Dexterity scores. Donning or removing a suit of unwound clockwork armor requires 10 minutes. When fully wound, a suit of clockwork armor can be donned or removed as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. It grants the wearer a +4 temporary enhancement bonus to Strength and Constitution, and its weight does not count against the wearer’s total encumbrance. A single crossbow or firearm sized appropriately for the wearer can be added to the armor with a successful DC 20 Craft (armorer) check. Such a weapon can be fired once as a standard action by the wearer, then automatically reloads itself in 2d4 rounds, as long as the wearer has the appropriate ammunition in his gear.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: animate objects

Name: Coruscating Raiment
Description: Originally crafted by jyoti armorsmiths of the Positive Energy Plane, this gleaming suit of +1 radiant full plate has a mirror-like sheen that reflects even tiny sparks of light into brilliant ribbons of blazing color. Its ability to shine as brightly as a torch cannot be suppressed unless the wearer is in magical darkness. Once per day as an immediate action while charging, the wearer can transform her body into brilliant light. The wearer becomes incorporeal until she arrives at the end of her charge and makes her physical attacks, and she can charge through any creatures and obstacles that do not hinder incorporeal creatures (although she must have line of sight to her target when she begins her charge, as normal).

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: sunburst

Name: Crag Linnorm Plate
Description: This specialized suit of full plate is made from the tanned hide of a linnorm and acts as +4 dragonhide plate. If a creature is slain while wearing such armor, its killer is subject to a curse. The cursed creature must succeed at a DC 17 Will save or gain vulnerability to fire until the curse is removed. This curse can be removed only by a break enchantment, miracle, or wish spell. This particular suit of armor is made from the hide of a crag linnorm, though others exist, each with a different curse effect similar to the curse of the associated linnorm. Once per day as a swift action, the wear of this armor can summon forth the uncanny movement powers of a linnorm, gaining the benefits of freedom of movement for 10 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: form of the dragon I, dreedom of movement, major curse

Name: Daystar Half-Plate
Description: This glowing +1 half-plate is decorated with various images of the sun and depictions of nature. At will, the wearer can command the armor to shine with a daylight spell for 10 minutes. Once per day, the wearer can command it to shine as per the sunburst spell. The sunburst is centered on the wearer and the wearer is immune to its effects.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: daylight, sunburst

Name: Death's Preservation Banded Mail
Description:
This +2 banded mail is etched with somber funerary imagery. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against death effects and negative energy effects.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of death ward for 9 minutes.

Death ward is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, death ward

Name: Demon Armor
Description:
This +4 full plate is forged in the Abyss and adorned with jagged spikes and demonic visages. The wearer gains fire resistance 10.

Once per day on command, the wearer can summon a babau demon, as summon monster V, to serve for 10 rounds.

In addition, three times per day on command, the wearer can release a 30-foot cone of fire that deals 6d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 18 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The summoning and cone of fire are CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fireball, summon monster V

Name: Diviner's Blight
Description:
This +1 chain shirt is etched with twisting sigils that seem to shift when observed. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against divination spells and spell-like abilities.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of nondetection for 7 hours.

Nondetection is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, nondetection

Name: Djezet Skin
Description:
This +2 leather armor is forged from rare djezet and gleams with a reddish metallic sheen. The wearer gains spell resistance 13.

Once per day as an immediate action when targeted by a spell that fails to overcome the armor’s spell resistance, the wearer can redirect the spell back at the original caster as if using spell turning, affecting only that spell.

Spell turning is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, spell resistance, spell turning

Name: Dragonform Armor
Description:
This +3 dragonhide full plate is crafted from the scales of a true dragon. Once per day on command, the wearer can assume the form of a Large dragon as if using dragonkind I for up to 10 minutes.

While transformed, the wearer retains the armor’s enhancement bonus to AC.

Dragonkind I is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dragonkind I

Name: Dragonhide Plate
Description: This masterwork full plate is crafted from dragonhide rather than metal. Dragonhide plate functions as normal full plate but can be worn by druids without violating their code of conduct.

Name: Dueling Armor
Description:
This +1 breastplate is etched with intricate patterns that shift subtly as the wearer moves. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls when making attacks of opportunity.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of blur for 8 rounds.

Blur is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, blur

Name: Dwarven Plate
Description:
This +2 full plate is crafted in the distinctive style of the dwarves and is fitted with reinforced plates and layered steel. The wearer gains a +4 bonus on CMD against bull rush and trip combat maneuvers.

In addition, the wearer can move at normal speed in heavy armor.

These effects are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bear's endurance

Name: Elemental Bulwark
Description:
This +2 breastplate is etched with symbols representing the four elements. The wearer gains resistance 10 against acid, cold, electricity, and fire.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of protection from energy against one energy type for 9 minutes.

Protection from energy is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, protection from energy, resist energy

Name: Elven Chain
Description:
This finely crafted +1 chain shirt is so light and flexible that it can be worn under normal clothing without betraying its presence. It is considered light armor and allows the wearer to use the full Dexterity bonus to AC as if not wearing armor.

Elven chain is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace

Name: Elven Dress Uniform
Description:
This +1 mithral chain shirt is tailored as a formal military uniform adorned with elegant elven insignia. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks and Perform (dance) checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can use charm monster (DC 17).

Charm monster is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, charm monster

Name: Elven Vengeance
Description:
This +2 elven chain is etched with scenes of ancient battles against orcs and other traditional enemies of the elves. The wearer gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC against creatures of the orc subtype and creatures with the goblinoid subtype.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of haste for 9 rounds.

Haste is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, haste

Name: Emissary’s Breastplate
Description:
This +1 breastplate is polished to a brilliant shine and adorned with the insignia of diplomatic authority. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of tongues for 7 minutes.

Tongues is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, tongues

Name: Empyreal Armor
Description:
This +3 full plate gleams with celestial light and bears the sigils of empyreal lords. The wearer gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against evil spells and spell-like abilities.

Three times per day as an immediate action when struck by a melee attack from an evil creature, the wearer can force that creature to succeed at a DC 18 Will save or be blinded for 1 round.

Once per day on command, the wearer can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of holy light. Evil creatures within the area take 5d8 points of damage (Will DC 18 half), and good creatures are healed 5d8 points of damage.

The save DCs are Charisma-based.

The burst is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy smite, searing light

Name: Enchanted Eelskin
Description:
This +1 leather armor is slick and faintly damp to the touch. The wearer gains a swim speed of 30 feet and a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can release a 15-foot cone of electricity that deals 4d6 points of electricity damage (Reflex DC 15 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The cone is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, lightning bolt, water breathing

Name: Equestrian Plate
Description:
This +2 full plate is specially fitted for mounted combat and bears elaborate barding motifs. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Ride checks.

While mounted, the wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of mount for 9 hours, though the summoned mount appears already saddled and barded.

Mount is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mount

Name: Eternal Iron Breastplate
Description:
This +2 breastplate is forged from dark, unyielding iron that never tarnishes or rusts. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to resist bull rush, overrun, and trip attempts.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of stoneskin for up to 90 points of damage.

Stoneskin is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, stoneskin

Name: Fangtide Scale Mail
Description:
This +2 scale mail is crafted from the fangs and scales of monstrous sea creatures. The wearer gains a swim speed of 20 feet and a +4 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can exhale a 30-foot cone of water that deals 6d6 points of bludgeoning damage (Reflex DC 17 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The breath weapon is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, control water, water breathing

Name: Field Medic's Breastplate
Description:
This +1 breastplate bears the symbol of a healing hand and is fitted with pouches for bandages and salves. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Heal checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can cast cure serious wounds on a touched creature.

Cure serious wounds is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cure serious wounds

Name: Flashguard Plate
Description:
This +2 full plate is polished to a mirror shine and fitted with reflective plates that flare with blinding light when struck. Three times per day as an immediate action when the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker must succeed at a DC 17 Reflex save or be blinded for 1 round.

Once per day on command, the wearer can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of brilliant light that functions as daylight and dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The burst is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, daylight, searing light

Name: Folding Plate
Description:
This +1 full plate can be folded into a compact, easily carried bundle the size of a small backpack as a full-round action. Unfolding the armor is also a full-round action.

While folded, the armor weighs only 10 pounds. When unfolded and worn, it functions as normal full plate.

Folding plate is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shrink item

Name: Forgemaster's Half-Plate
Description:
This +1 half-plate is etched with runes of the forge and constantly radiates a faint warmth. The wearer gains fire resistance 10 and a +4 competence bonus on Craft (armor) and Craft (weapons) checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of resist energy (fire only) for 7 minutes.

Resist energy is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, resist energy

Name: Forsaken Banded Mail
Description:
This +2 banded mail is etched with grim symbols of despair and loss. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can cast bestow curse (DC 17) on a creature struck with a melee attack.

Bestow curse is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bestow curse

Name: Full Plate of the Corpse
Description:
This +2 full plate is fashioned to resemble a stitched and armored corpse. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against disease, paralysis, poison, and sleep effects.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of false life for 9 hours.

False life is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, false life, remove disease

Name: Gale Armor
Description:
This +2 chainmail is etched with swirling wind patterns. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Fly checks and a +2 competence bonus on Reflex saves.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of fly for 9 minutes.

Fly is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly

Name: Gelugon Armor
Description:
This +3 full plate is forged from infernal iron and rimed with perpetual frost. The wearer gains cold resistance 30.

Whenever the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes 2d6 points of cold damage.

Once per day on command, the wearer can unleash a 30-foot cone of freezing air that deals 10d6 points of cold damage (Reflex DC 19 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The cone is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cone of cold, resist energy

Name: Gelugon Plate
Description:
This +1 full plate is cold to the touch and etched with infernal runes. The wearer gains cold resistance 10.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can release a 15-foot cone of frost that deals 4d6 points of cold damage (Reflex DC 15 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The cone is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cone of cold, resist energy

Name: Ghoul Hide
Description:
This +2 hide armor is stitched from the pallid skin of ghouls and exudes a faint odor of decay. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against paralysis and disease.

Once per day on command, the wearer can deliver a touch that functions as ghoul touch (DC 17).

Ghoul touch is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ghoul touch

Name: Giant-Hide Armor
Description:
This +2 hide armor is fashioned from the thick skin of a giant. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to resist bull rush and overrun attempts.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of enlarge person for 9 rounds.

Enlarge person is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, enlarge person

Name: Gloom Mail
Description:
This +2 chainmail seems to absorb light rather than reflect it. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks in areas of dim light or darkness.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of invisibility for up to 7 minutes.

Invisibility is CL 7th.
